items.prompt: What ordering claim should this function make about malformed cyclic child references?

options.text: It repairs the cycle and returns a corrected tree.
options.why: No structural repair protocol is implemented.

options.text: It proves the malformed graph is connected.
options.why: Ordering checks do not establish or repair arbitrary graph structure.

options.text: No guarantee: proper indexed-tree structure is a precondition.
options.why: Do not infer structural validation or invent new accepted-domain rules from this ordering routine.

options.text: It converts every repeated reference into an empty child.
options.why: The function does not rewrite caller child indexes.

items.explanation: Do not infer structural validation or invent new accepted-domain rules from this ordering routine.
